EQUIPMENT PURCHASE AGREEMENT

This Equipment Purchase Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of
June 15, 2026, between Precision Robotics Corp. ("Seller") and Cascade
Foods Processing Inc. ("Buyer").

1. EQUIPMENT SOLD

1.1 Seller shall manufacture, deliver, and install six (6) Model PR-4400
automated packaging units (the "Equipment") at Buyer's facility located
in Portland, Oregon.

1.2 Delivery and Installation. Seller shall deliver and install the
Equipment within sixty (60) days of the Effective Date. Title and control
of the Equipment transfer to Buyer upon Buyer's written acceptance
following successful installation and calibration testing, expected to
occur on or before the 60-day delivery deadline.

2. EXTENDED WARRANTY

2.1 In addition to the Equipment, Seller shall provide a three (3) year
Extended Warranty covering parts, labor, and quarterly preventive
maintenance visits for the Equipment, commencing upon Buyer's acceptance
of the Equipment and continuing for thirty-six (36) months thereafter.

2.2 The Extended Warranty is a separately priced, optional service that
Buyer elected to purchase in addition to the Equipment itself; Buyer could
have declined the Extended Warranty and purchased the Equipment alone
under Seller's standard one-year manufacturer's warranty at no additional
charge. Because the Extended Warranty is separately priced and provides
services distinct from and in addition to the Equipment, it constitutes a
distinct performance obligation from the Equipment sale.

3. PURCHASE PRICE

3.1 Equipment Price. The purchase price for the six (6) Equipment units,
inclusive of delivery and installation, is $540,000, due upon Buyer's
written acceptance of the Equipment.

3.2 Extended Warranty Price. The price for the three (3) year Extended
Warranty is $81,000, payable in a single upfront payment due upon Buyer's
acceptance of the Equipment, covering the 36-month warranty period.

3.3 Total Purchase Price. The total amount due under this Agreement is
$621,000.

4. WARRANTY SERVICE DELIVERY

4.1 Under the Extended Warranty, Seller shall perform quarterly preventive
maintenance visits and shall respond to any parts or labor service request
within forty-eight (48) hours, for the full thirty-six (36) month covered
period following Equipment acceptance.

5. RISK OF LOSS

5.1 Risk of loss for the Equipment transfers to Buyer upon Buyer's written
acceptance following successful installation and calibration testing.

6. GENERAL PROVISIONS

6.1 Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of
Oregon.

6.2 Entire Agreement. This Agreement, including its exhibits, constitutes
the entire agreement between the parties.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement.

Precision Robotics Corp.                     Cascade Foods Processing Inc.
